prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a snow-covered path bordered by a metal railing, moving forward through a misty, snowy landscape. The camera smoothly transitions from the initial foggy view to clearer sections, revealing a rugged terrain of rocks and patches of snow under a bright blue sky. As the journey progresses, the path narrows, leading the viewer past steep rocky inclines and sparse vegetation. The camera pans slightly to capture the expansive mountainous backdrop, showcasing distant peaks dusted with snow. The movement remains consistent, with occasional shifts in angle to emphasize the steepness of the trail and the vastness of the surrounding wilderness. The natural light enhances the contrast between the white snow and the dark, jagged rocks, creating a vivid visual experience. The scene remains empty, devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude and untouched beauty of the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera continues its forward motion, maintaining a clear focus on the path ahead while occasionally glancing at the breathtaking scenery on either side.
